title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4WATR - EnvironmentalProperty
description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4watr/EnvironmentalProperty. Class to group those properties related to the environment. Subclass of saref:Property (an imported SAREF core class, not separately modeled in this repository), with no properties of its own. Unlike the other SAREF4WATR property-grouping classes, EnvironmentalProperty is not referenced by any explicit OWL restriction in the ontology (no class has an allValuesFrom/someValuesFrom restriction pointing at it); it stands as general-purpose ambient/environmental controlled vocabulary, typically useful alongside GaugingStation/MonitoringInfrastructure/Water observations. Named individuals of this class defined in the ontology: AtmosphericPressure, ExternalTemperature, Humidity, Precipitation.

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'EnvironmentalProperty'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.
